nodes.name: Truncate cao_chunks
nodes.notes: Wipes cao_chunks before re-ingest. Requires a Postgres credential (Supabase pooler URL). If you don't want to use Postgres, disable this node and run TRUNCATE manually in the Supabase SQL editor before each ingest.

meta.description: Ingest markdown uit GitHub repo cao-knowledge-base. Truncate cao_chunks → list per hoofdstuk-folder → merge → filter → get → CAO Code node (chunken op H1/H2 met meta-block parsing) → insert cao_chunks via Google embedding + data loader.
